component.name: OpenDraft
component.summary: Free, open-source 2D CAD with an AutoCAD-style command line

description.p: OpenDraft is a fast, free 2D CAD application for people who think in command lines. Type L, press Enter and click two points: a ribbon, a real command line with the standard drafting command names and short aliases, and step-by-step prompts with options.

ul.li: Opens DXF and DWG drawings (including files saved by AutoCAD 2010 to 2018), saves DXF, and has its own .odx format
Layers, linetypes, blocks, hatches, dimensions, multiline text and layouts
Every change is one undo step; saves are atomic, with autosave and crash recovery
An optional, off-by-default connection that lets an AI assistant inspect and draw in open drawings, with every change undoable

description.p: OpenDraft is in early development: features and the .odx format may still change.
